notifications.treatmentHint: On the chosen days and time, if the intake isn't logged yet.
notifications.ritualsHint: A card on the home screen on the day, and a morning notification.
notifications.weighInHint: Once a week, on the day you choose.
notifications.progressPhotoHint: Once a month, optional and private.

plan.title: Weekly menu
plan.intro: The menu is shared by the household: anyone can add or remove a dish.
plan.label: Dish name
plan.labelHint: For an idea without a recipe, such as “Leftovers” or “Homemade pizza”.
plan.noRecipes: No recipe yet: create one, or let the coach suggest some.
plan.generateTitle: Ask the coach for a menu
plan.generateHint: The coach fills the meals still empty from today, with your recipes or new dishes (saved in your recipes). Calories come from the food database.
plan.generating: The coach is putting the menu together…

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.intro: Shared by the household: anyone can tick or add an item, and the list updates by itself.
shopping.filled: {count, plural, =0 {No ingredient in this week's menu (only recipes have some).} one {# item from the menu.} other {# items from the menu.}}
shopping.fromMenuHint: Quantities follow the number of servings. Items added by hand or already ticked stay.
shopping.label: Item

fridge.title: Scan the fridge
fridge.intro: Take a photo of your fridge or cupboard: the coach spots the ingredients and suggests 3 ideas. The photo isn't kept.
fridge.analyzing: The coach is looking at what you have…
fridge.over: A little above what you have left
fridge.save: Save and add to the log
fridge.noIdeas: No idea this time: try a sharper or wider photo.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: The family's recipes and simple ideas, with calories worked out from the Ciqual table.

recipes.noMatch: No recipe matches. Try another word.

training.title: Training
training.intro: Workouts matched to your level, equipment and time, always with a warm-up and a cool-down.
training.disclaimer: These workouts are general suggestions, not medical advice. Listen to your body: if something hurts, stop the exercise and flag it. If you have any doubt about your health, ask a professional.

setup.title: My training profile
setup.intro: A few questions to build your program. You can change everything later.
setup.equipmentHint: Tick what you have at hand.
setup.zonesHint: Exercises that load them won't be suggested.
setup.saved: Profile saved, your program is ready.

levels.beginnerHint: I'm starting or getting back into it.
levels.intermediateHint: I've been moving regularly for a few months.
levels.advancedHint: I've been training regularly for a long time.

home.rest: Rest day: recovery is part of the program.
home.replaceHint: Another workout of the same type and length.
home.expressHint: A short circuit for busy days.
home.onDemandHint: Pick a length, the rest is prepared for you.
home.streak: {count, plural, =0 {Your first workout starts your streak of active weeks.} one {# active week in a row} other {# active weeks in a row}}
home.personalizing: The coach is preparing tips for the week…
home.doneToday: Workout done today: {kcal} kcal added to your daily budget.

snack.before: If your last meal was more than 3 hours ago, a light snack 1 hour before helps: a banana, toast with honey or a fruit purée.
snack.after: In the following hours, think protein: plain yogurt and a handful of almonds, or a glass of milk and a piece of fruit.
snack.afterPlant: In the following hours, think protein: soy yogurt and a handful of almonds, or roasted chickpeas and a piece of fruit.

session.painDone: Exercise set aside: it won't be suggested again. Moving on.
session.feelingHint: Your feedback adjusts next week's difficulty.
session.awake: Screen kept on during the workout.
session.unavailable: This workout is no longer in the program.

history.noRecords: Your records will show up after your first workouts.

library.title: Exercise library
library.intro: Every exercise in the app, with instructions and a gentler variant. Exercise descriptions are in French.
library.count: {count, plural, =0 {No exercise} one {# exercise} other {# exercises}}
library.excludedHint: Flagged during a workout, they are no longer suggested.
library.customHint: To keep track of your own exercises (they are not added to suggested workouts).
library.name: Name

body.title: Body
body.intro: Your measurements and progress photos, visible only to you. The tape measure often tells what the scale doesn't.
body.empty: No measurements yet. One first measurement is enough to start.

photos.title: Progress photo
photos.privacy: Your photos stay private: protected storage, never shared or analysed by AI. Same light and same pose each time make the comparison clearer.

activity.title: Activity
activity.goalHint: These calories are added to today's goal, and your macros follow. Sessions from the Training space count too.
activity.intensityHint: Light: you talk easily. Moderate: you can talk but not sing. Vigorous: a few words at a time.
activity.empty: No activity logged in the last few days.

steps.title: Steps
steps.hint: Your activity level already includes about {baseline, number} steps a day: only steps above that add calories.

import.title: Import a file
import.hint: CSV export from Google Fit, Apple Health or a watch: Pommelia finds the date, steps, activity type and duration columns. Importing the same days again replaces the previous import.
import.done: Import complete: {days, plural, =0 {no step days} one {# step day} other {# step days}}, {activities, plural, =0 {no activities} one {# activity} other {# activities}}, {skipped, plural, =0 {no rows skipped} one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}.

fasting.title: Fasting
fasting.intro: A window to eat, a window to pause. You choose your rhythm day by day, and you can stop whenever you like.
fasting.minor: Intermittent fasting isn't offered under 18. Your body needs regular meals while growing: keep logging your meals as usual.
fasting.disclaimer: Pommelia doesn't give medical advice. If you have diabetes, are pregnant or breastfeeding, have a history of eating disorders or take medication, talk to a health professional before fasting.

timer.title: Timer
timer.remaining: {h} h {m} min left before your eating window.
timer.reached: Goal reached, well done! Your eating window is open whenever you like.

plan.title: My schedule
plan.autoStartHint: The fast starts on its own at the planned time and stops on its own at the end of the window. You can always stop it earlier.
plan.daysHint: Choose a protocol (fasting hours : eating hours) and the time your fast starts.

history.title: History
history.stats: {completed, plural, =0 {No goal reached} one {# goal reached} other {# goals reached}} in the last 7 days · average length {h} h {m} min.

treatment.title: Treatment
treatment.intro: A simple log of when you take your treatment, with reminders if you like.
treatment.disclaimer: Pommelia never calculates or recommends any dose. Follow your doctor's prescription and ask them your questions about your treatment.

log.title: Log an intake
log.name: Name
log.noteHint: Optional: how you feel, injection site, missed intake…

add.title: Add a treatment
add.name: Name
add.nameHint: Any name you like, for example your medication's name.
add.reminderHint: Choose days and a time; no reminder is sent if the intake is already logged.
